name: bug
description: Something isn't working: should prefix branch by bug/

name: design
description: design work (Figma), usually a sub-issue of the feat it designs

name: docs
description: Improvements or additions to documentation: should prefix branch by docs/

name: feat
description: New feature or request: should prefix branch by feat/

name: hold:blocked
description: waiting for something outside the team, or for another issue

name: hold:paused
description: deprioritized, or its developer away for a while

name: perf
description: A code change that improves perforamnce: should prefix branch by perf/

name: polish
description: Clean up of UI, UX or phrasing (small changes <30mn): should prefix branch by polish/

name: refactor
description: Refactor code structure or implementation: should prefix branch by refactor/

name: style
description: Changes that do not affect the meaning of the code (white-space, formatting, missing semi-colons etc

name: test
description: Adding missing tests or correcting existing tests: should prefix branch by test/
